text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup— A race where the 
"strongest" Umamusume assemble.

Over the classic distance of 2,400 meters, 
on this royal course where the Tokyo 
Yushun (Japanese Derby) is contested...

The "strongest" among the "strongest" will 
be decided.

And what many spectators are anticipating 
is—

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Buena Vistaaaaa!! Please winnnnn!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Buena-saaan! Go, go, go! Ke-ppa-re!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
—Now, just listen to this! The massive 
cheers echoing out for Buena Vista...!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
She remains the undisputed #1 favorite in 
"The 1st"! She commands the fans' 
unwavering support across every race she 
enters!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, ever since we performed 
together, I've been a huge fan of Buena 
Vista-san...!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
I'll be cheering with all my might today! 
Do your best, Buena Vista-sa~n!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh~, Buena-chan's popularity is insane. 
She's totally the main character.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Seriously... What a bunch of classmates...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —That is truly a great back to look up to.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However, I cannot afford to lose. I will 
bring down that giant tower here... and 
keep stacking victories right on schedule.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Shion-san, you're on the same schedule, 
aren't you?

Alongside Eishin Flash and Win Variation, 
a new generation of Umamusume had gathered 
to face Buena Vista.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...I just... don't want to lose to 
anyone. That's all."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
In a race without her, I won't lose. —Even 
if Buena-san is my opponent.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...It's not like I plan on losing either, 
y'know?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Seeing someone from my own class tearing 
it up... There's no way in hell I wouldn't 
care.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, time to tear it up! âMake way 
for the queen of the era!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Buena-chan... You always said your goal 
was the Japan Cup, right?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Hold on...! Hang in there...!!

Expectations fill the air. The feelings of 
tens of thousands of people, each and 
every one—sparkling like particles.
choice_data_list: (――That time was one of those moments.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "Spe-saaaan! Do your beeeest!!"
Yet right now—

I'll be the one shining light upon tens of 
thousands of hopes and dreams.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...We've finally made it here.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "The stage where our dreams come true—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...No, we're going to make it come true. 
With these legs... and with both our 
hearts.
choice_data_list:
...Buena, you're the only one who can go 
beyond this point.

...Buena, you're the only one who can go 
beyond this point.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You'll fight alongside me, won't you? Just 
like everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"It'll be okay, Buena can definitely 
win...! She can win, she can win, she will 
win...!"

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
...All I can do is pray, but... Still...! 
I want to pray...! —Win this, 
Buena-san...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one running. But so many pure, 
hopeful expectations... are pushing me 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Let's fulfill…… the promise from that day!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hey... will you take that step with me?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Ready, set...!
